def main():
    total_chars = int(input().strip())
    input_line = input()

    total_words_in_braces = 0
    max_word_length = 0

    in_braces_flag = False
    current_word = []

    def update_word_count_and_max_length(word, in_braces, consumer):
        length = len(word)
        if length > 0:
            consumer(length)

    for index in range(total_chars):
        ch = input_line[index]

        if ch == '_':
            update_word_count_and_max_length(current_word, in_braces_flag, lambda length: (
                nonlocal total_words_in_braces, max_word_length
                if length > 0:
                    (total_words_in_braces := total_words_in_braces + 1) if in_braces_flag else None,
                    max_word_length := max(max_word_length, length)
            ))
            current_word = []
        elif ch == '(':
            update_word_count_and_max_length(current_word, in_braces_flag, lambda length: (
                nonlocal total_words_in_braces, max_word_length
                if length > 0:
                    (total_words_in_braces := total_words_in_braces + 1) if in_braces_flag else None,
                    max_word_length := max(max_word_length, length)
            ))
            current_word = []
            in_braces_flag = True
        elif ch == ')':
            update_word_count_and_max_length(current_word, in_braces_flag, lambda length: (
                nonlocal total_words_in_braces, max_word_length
                if length > 0:
                    (total_words_in_braces := total_words_in_braces + 1) if in_braces_flag else None,
                    max_word_length := max(max_word_length, length)
            ))
            current_word = []
            in_braces_flag = False
        elif ch.isalpha():
            current_word.append(ch)

    update_word_count_and_max_length(current_word, in_braces_flag, lambda length: (
        nonlocal total_words_in_braces, max_word_length
        if length > 0:
            (total_words_in_braces := total_words_in_braces + 1) if in_braces_flag else None,
            max_word_length := max(max_word_length, length)
    ))

    print(f"{max_word_length} {total_words_in_braces}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
